raw_response:
I have planted these root crops on this same soil for many years using cuttings from my own harvest, and they still feed my family without me buying anything from the shop. I am too old now to carry heavy bags of fertilizer, and we have no money to throw away on chemicals for just this small piece of land. My children and grandchildren will come to help with the digging and weeding, so we do not need to pay workers from outside. We wait for the rains as our ancestors always did, because only the wealthy can afford to pump water.
